title: M/S Mohan Ice Chiller v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Pankaj Mithal, J.; Saral Srivastava, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; liberty to seek Clause 6.14 instalments from Executive Engineer.
headnote: A consumer seeking time or instalments to pay electricity arrears (and disconnection) must apply to the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The High Court disposed of the writ with liberty to apply within two weeks, directing the Executive Engineer to consider the request in accordance with law and to fix instalments if necessary.
facts: The petitioner, M/S Mohan Ice Chiller, challenged a demand notice dated 6 May 2019 for electricity arrears of Rs.10,54,335. It told the Court that it wished to have the supply disconnected and was ready to clear the entire outstanding if given reasonable time or if the dues were spread in instalments. Counsel for the distribution licensee (respondent No. 4) appeared. The petitioner did not press a merits challenge to the demand itself.

holding_units.holding: A consumer who seeks instalments to clear outstanding electricity dues has a remedy before the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The writ is disposed of with liberty to approach the Executive Engineer within two weeks; the Executive Engineer shall consider the request in accordance with law and fix instalments if necessary.

not_decided.point: Validity of the demand of Rs.10,54,335 dated 06.05.2019
not_decided.note: Not examined on merits; the petitioner sought time or instalments to pay.

not_decided.point: Whether instalments must in fact be granted
not_decided.note: Left to the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.14, to fix instalments if necessary.
